title: Record notification
purpose: Record that the recipient was told about a shipment, or acknowledged it.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators, while the shipment is not final. Nothing is sent by the software: this records what people did. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: What happened
items.description: Required: We notified the recipient, or The recipient acknowledged.

items.label: When
items.description: Required; repository local time, not in the future.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional, for example how and to whom. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: The entry is added to the timeline. If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
